response.text:
I can’t directly access or change your mailbox from here. I can, however, give exact steps and search filters so you can remove everything from Uber quickly.

For Gmail (web) — recommended (bulk + future messages)
1. In the Gmail search box, paste:
   from:(uber)
   and press Enter.  
   (If you want to be stricter: from:(@uber.com OR @ride.uber.com OR @uber.co) )
2. To delete existing results:
   - Click the checkbox at the top left to select the page.
   - If there are more than one page, click the blue link that appears: “Select all conversations that match this search.”
   - Click the Trash icon (Delete).
3. To auto-remove future Uber messages:
   - Click the down-arrow in the search box (or Settings → See all settings → Filters and Blocked Addresses → Create a new filter).
   - In the “From” field put: uber
   - Click “Create filter”.
   - Check “Delete it” and check “Also apply filter to matching conversations”.
   - Click “Create filter”.

Gmail (mobile app)
1. Tap the search bar, enter: from:(uber) and run the search.
2. Tap the avatar/checkmark to select messages; to delete many at once tap and hold the first, then select more, then Delete.
(Note: mobile may not show “select all conversations” — use the web UI for large-volume deletions and to create a filter.)

Other useful options
- Unsubscribe: open one Uber promotional email and click its “unsubscribe” link (if present).
- Block addresses: open a message → menu (three dots) → “Block [sender]”.
- Change Uber account notification settings on Uber’s website/app to reduce emails.

If you want, I can:
- Provide the exact search string/filter text to copy/paste.
- Provide short instructions for another mail client (Outlook, Apple Mail).
Tell me which and I’ll give that immediately.
